endorsements.name: Michael L. Davis
endorsements.label: Who Invented the Proximity Card?
endorsements.description: Who invented the first Proximity Card System? And what security company dismissed it as a mere magician's trick? And what does this have to do with goldfish? Stop by and take a trip down memory lane as we explore the history of a prolific inventor who was one of the founding fathers of the physical security industry. (Hint: This person was a musician with perfect pitch whose first patent was for an automatic garage door opener.)
